extensions.name: MangaDex
extensions.description: Open scanlation catalog, ~80k titles. Stable JSON API. v1.1.1 swaps the chapter_list smoke fixture from Komi Can't Communicate (which lost ~497 of 500 EN chapters to licensing takedowns and broke installs/updates) to Berserk, which has ~500 EN chapters and is resilient to scanlation-group churn. v1.1.0 added chapter_count + tags in search hits for client-side filtering.

extensions.name: Comick
extensions.description: Multi-language scanlation hub. Uses comick.art's plain-JSON API; covers and pages routed through manga-img:// proxy to add the required Referer.

extensions.name: Internet Archive
extensions.description: Public-domain comics, scanlations, and user uploads from archive.org. Each IA item = one single-volume manga (no series grouping). Search is restricted to image-mediatype items with unpacked JPEG/PNG pages; items with CBZ-packed pages will show 0 readable pages.

extensions.name: Webtoons
extensions.description: Official LINE Webtoons (Naver). Korean & American webcomics with English translations. Vertical-scroll format; one episode = one continuous strip rendered as multiple JPEG images. Cover and page CDN (webtoon-phinf.pstatic.net) is hotlink-protected, routed through manga-img:// to add the required Referer.

extensions.name: Manhwa18
extensions.description: Explicit Korean manhwa aggregator. HTML-scraped from manhwa18.com. Mature content throughout; the include_nsfw preference is accepted but is a no-op (entire catalog is 18+). Chapter id is `<manga-slug>/<chapter-slug>` and is injected raw to preserve the slash through URL-encoding.

extensions.name: Manga18fx
extensions.description: Explicit Korean / Japanese manhwa aggregator. HTML-scraped from manga18fx.com. Non-standard layout (custom .bsx-item cards, row-content-chapter list) — not Madara. Mature content throughout; include_nsfw is a no-op since the whole catalog is 18+. Chapter id is `<slug>/chapter-N` injected raw to preserve the slash.

extensions.name: Manga District
extensions.description: Madara-themed WordPress aggregator (mangadistrict.com) with a mixed adult + SFW catalog, heavily skewed toward mature Korean manhwa and BL/yaoi. URL shape `/series/<slug>/chapter-N/`; reader uses direct `src=` images (not lazy data-src). Chapter id is `<slug>/chapter-N` injected raw to preserve the slash.

extensions.name: PornHwa18
extensions.description: Explicit pornhwa aggregator (pornhwa18.com) built on Qwik SSR — NOT Madara. All page content is in the server-rendered HTML, so no JS execution is required. URL shape `/comic/<slug>/chapter-N/`; chapter dates are relative ("1 day ago") and converted to absolute Unix seconds at scrape time. Entire catalog is 18+. v1.0.1: chapter_list id AND number no longer rely on item.attrs.href (Dart mobile runtime doesn't bind it). Pulls href from item.html instead.

extensions.name: Manhwax
extensions.description: Explicit Korean manhwa aggregator (manhwax.top) on the MangaThemesia WordPress theme. URL shape `/manga/<slug>/` for details and flat `/<slug>-chapter-N-english/` for reader. Reader extracts a ts_reader.run({"sources":[{"images":[…]}]}) JSON blob; images live on imgbox.com (no Referer required). Entire catalog is 18+.

extensions.name: MangaFox (FanFox)
extensions.description: Mainstream English manga aggregator hosting classics like Naruto, One Piece, and Bleach. Desktop reader uses per-page chapterfun.ashx AJAX with p,a,c,k,e,d obfuscation — we instead point page_list at the mobile roll_manga endpoint (m.fanfox.net) which inlines every page in a single HTML response. The `readway=2` cookie is required to receive all pages rather than the 3-page preview. Both covers (fmcdn.mfcdn.net) and pages (zjcdn.mangafox.me) are hotlink-protected and routed through manga-img:// for the Referer.

extensions.name: TCB Scans
extensions.description: English fan-scanlation group covering One Piece, Jujutsu Kaisen, My Hero Academia, Black Clover, Attack on Titan, Chainsaw Man, and other weekly Shonen Jump series. Small catalog (~15 titles) — high translation quality. Live host is `tcbonepiecechapters.com`; legacy `tcbscans.com` redirects here. There is no server search endpoint — Mihon implements it client-side over /projects, and so do we (the {query} placeholder is encoded into a no-op `_q=` param so the URL template validator passes). v1.0.1: chapter_list id no longer relies on item.attrs.href (Dart mobile runtime doesn't bind it). Pulls href from item.html instead.

extensions.name: Mangapill
extensions.description: Mainstream English manga aggregator with a clean, predictable HTML structure (no client-side hydration). Hosts Naruto, One Piece, Bleach, and most modern series. URL shape `/manga/<id>/<slug>` for details and `/chapters/<id>-<NNNNNN>/<slug>-chapter-N` for reader. Pages served by `cdn.readdetectiveconan.com` and hotlink-protected — routed through manga-img:// to add the required Referer. v1.0.1: chapter_list id no longer relies on item.attrs.href (Dart mobile runtime doesn't bind it). Pulls href from item.html instead.

extensions.name: MangaRead
extensions.description: English Madara-themed WordPress aggregator with a large mainstream catalog (Naruto, Boruto, One Piece, Bleach, Vagabond, Slam Dunk, etc.). Reader is plain — pages live in `wp-manga-chapter-img` src attributes directly (no chapter-protector AES blob). Pages served from `www.mangaread.org` itself under /wp-content/uploads/; no hotlink protection.

extensions.name: MangaKatana
extensions.description: Mainstream English manga aggregator. Large catalog including Naruto, Bleach, Vagabond, and Berserk. Reader uses a JS trick: HTML carries placeholder `` tags and the real URLs live in a `var =['url1',…];` inline script. We extract the variable name via Mihon's regex `data-src['"]?,\s*(\w+)` and parse the array. URL shape `/manga/.` for details and `/manga/./c` for reader. Pages on i1.mangakatana.com — no hotlink protection. v1.0.1: handle single-result 302 redirect (e.g. exact-title queries like "knights of sidonia" go straight to /manga/sidonia-no-kishi.2070 instead of returning a list). Items selector now matches div#book_list > div.item OR div#single_book; field extractors fall through to detail-page shape, with the slug recovered from in response.html.

extensions.name: WeebCentral
extensions.description: Mangasee/Manga4Life's official successor (rebranded Jan 2025). Massive shounen-leaning catalog; HTMX endpoints return clean parseable HTML with no JS hydration step. CDN scans-hot.planeptune.us. v0.1.2 fixes five silent bugs: WeebCentral 403s default Dart/Dio UAs and the runtime ignores `default_headers`, so a top-level `user_agent` is now declared; bare `article` items selector was double-matching (outer card + nested cover wrapper); chapter_list id reached for `item.attrs.href` which the runtime doesn't bind, dropping every chapter; published_at regex targeted `checkNewChapter()` on the parent div which sits outside the anchor item; page_list used a comma-grouped `@attr` selector that the spec parser leaves unparseable.

extensions.name: Dynasty Scans
extensions.description: Long-running yuri / GL / 4-koma / specialty doujinshi archive. Smaller than the mainstream sources but zero overlap with the rest of the registry — they translate niche material no one else picks up. v0.1.1: chapter_list id no longer relies on item.attrs.href (only bound on the desktop Rust runtime, not the Dart mobile runtime — see WeebCentral v0.1.2 changelog for the same fix pattern). Pulls href from item.html instead so the extension works on both runtimes.

extensions.name: HiperDex
extensions.description: Madara-themed Korean manhwa aggregator. Broad romance + mature-romance coverage (mid-tier suggestive content that the existing hardcore adult sources skip). CDN i1.r2d2storage.com. v0.1.1: Madara theme dropped the __content suffix on result wrappers as of 2026-05; switched search items selector from div.c-tabs-item__content to div.page-item-detail.manga (verified live). v0.1.2: chapter_list id no longer relies on item.attrs.href (Dart mobile runtime doesn't bind it; Rust desktop runtime does — silent mobile breakage). Pulls href from item.html instead.

extensions.name: ManhuaScan
extensions.description: Chinese manhua / xianxia / cultivation aggregator (Martial Peak, Apotheosis, etc.). Shares CDN with manga18fx. Caveat: search-by-title behaves like browse-by-keyword. v0.1.1: Site moved off Madara theme; chapter rows now use .chbox / .eph-num instead of li.wp-manga-chapter. Items selector switched to div.eph-num a, with a[href*='/chapter-'] fallback. v0.1.2: chapter_list id AND number no longer rely on item.attrs.href (Dart mobile runtime doesn't bind it). Pulls href from item.html instead.

extensions.name: HentaiFox
extensions.description: Japanese-origin doujinshi gallery — fills the JP gap in the existing adult bucket (which is otherwise all Korean manhwa). Pages built deterministically from load_dir / load_id / load_pages hidden inputs. v0.1.1: Chapter_list id field now reads response.base_url (the field actually exposed in the runtime binding) instead of response.url (undefined), which was returning '' for every row and tripping the empty-id drop guard. v0.1.2: page_list regex switched from response.html (scraper-reserialized, sometimes drops value attrs on hidden inputs) to response.raw (original fetched body).

extensions.name: ImHentai
extensions.description: Sister host to HentaiFox with meaningfully different catalog — Western porn comics, 3D, Chinese doujin. Same engine but uses an alphanumeric load_id for CDN path resolution. v0.1.1: Same chapter_list response.url → response.base_url fix as hentaifox v0.1.1 (sister site, identical scrape pattern). v0.1.2: page_list regex switched from response.html (scraper-reserialized, sometimes drops value attrs on hidden inputs) to response.raw (original fetched body).

extensions.name: Toonily
extensions.description: Korean manhwa aggregator (adult-focused) on the Madara WordPress theme. Behind Cloudflare. Mobile uses fetch_strategy: webview_proxied with the og:locale ready-marker; desktop's reqwest+rustls TLS fingerprint passes CF directly with a pinned Chrome UA, so no WebView is needed there. v1.1.3 strips the legacy `needs_browser_session: true` flag that was hard-bailing desktop's CfBypass stub before any fetch ran, leaving Toonily unusable on desktop even though the network path worked.

extensions.name: ManhuaPlus
extensions.description: Chinese manhua aggregator (xianxia / wuxia / cultivation) on the Madara WordPress theme. Long-backlog catalog — Martial Peak alone is 3000+ chapters; complements ManhuaScan's similar but shallower coverage. Direct-Dio path works with a pinned Chrome User-Agent (no Cloudflare gate). URL shape `/manga/<slug>/` for details and `/manga/<slug>/chapter-N/` for reader; chapter id is `<manga-slug>/<chapter-slug>` injected raw. v1.0.1: Reader page wrapper class is `reading-content-wrap` not `reading-content`; pages selector now anchors on the cdn.manhuaplus.com host. Smoke fixture moved from chapter-1 (currently shells) to chapter-3000 (stable mid-series with full page set).

extensions.name: MangaClash
extensions.description: Mainstream English manga aggregator on the Madara WordPress theme. Mid-sized SFW catalog (Naruto, One Piece, Boruto, Tower of God). Cloudflare-hard-blocked for direct fetches with a 'Sorry, you have been blocked' page (no JS challenge), so the manifest opts into fetch_strategy: webview_proxied — real Android Chrome reaches Yoast/Madara markup organically. URL shape `/manga/<slug>/` for details and `/manga/<slug>/chapter-N/` for reader; chapter id is `<manga-slug>/<chapter-slug>` injected raw to preserve the slash.

extensions.name: TCB Scans
extensions.description: Specialist scanlation group — weekly One Piece releases (complete archive ch 1–1182+) plus 18 other Shonen Jump titles (Jujutsu Kaisen, Bleach, Black Clover, Chainsaw Man, Hunter X Hunter, My Hero Academia, Attack on Titan, etc.). No search endpoint; catalog is the static /projects page, fetched per search and filtered client-side by the host's fuzzy scorer. v1.0.1: Dropped the literal 'One Piece' first_title_contains check — TCB's fuzzy search now returns a localized variant first. min_results guard is enough for the smoke; chapter_list/page_list cover real coverage. v1.0.2: chapter_list id no longer relies on item.attrs.href (Dart mobile runtime doesn't bind it). Pulls href from item.html instead.

extensions.name: MangaFire
extensions.description: Modern English manga aggregator. URL shape /manga/<slug>.<short-id> for details, /read/<slug>.<short-id>/<lang>/<chapter> for reader. Cloudflare-protected with Turnstile (live-confirmed 2026-05) — fetch_strategy: webview_proxied so the mobile runtime routes through CloudflareResolver; desktop has no Tauri WebView resolver and cannot exercise this source. SPECULATIVE: selectors still need live in-app verification on mobile — page_list / chapter_list extractors have not been confirmed against rendered MangaFire HTML. v0.1.1: chapter_list id no longer relies on item.attrs.href (Dart mobile runtime doesn't bind it). Pulls href from item.html instead.

extensions.name: MangaTown
extensions.description: Long-running English aggregator (MangaHere sibling). Plain HTML, no JS hydration on catalog/search/detail. Direct Dio/reqwest fetch — no Cloudflare gate. URL shape /manga/<slug>/ for details; chapters at /manga/<slug>/c<NNN>/ or /manga/<slug>/v<NN>/c<NNN>/ for older volume-organized series like Sidonia no Kishi. v0.1.1: corrected detail-page status label regex (literal 'Status(s):' not 'Status:'); rewrote author extractor to capture the linked <a class="color_0077"> text instead of empty whitespace; switched description to og:description meta (no .summary class exists on detail page); chapter_list id pulls href from item.html (Dart mobile runtime doesn't bind item.attrs.href); accepts volume-prefixed chapter URLs (v01/c001-style); tightened search items selector to drop nav/footer noise; smoke fixture switched from knights_of_sidonia (32 chapters, c001 unavailable) to sidonia_no_kishi (complete 78-chapter run, v01/c001 reader works). KNOWN GAP: reader is one-image-per-fetch (no batch endpoint); page_list smoke remains failing until runtime gains a per-page iterator.
